cohort: 46 preterm infants (21 cesarean and 25 vaginal), median gestational age 27 weeks
finding: Unlike term infants, birth mode was not significantly associated with changes in microbial diversity, composition, specific taxa, or overall microbial development in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Birth mode was not significantly associated with changes in microbial diversity, composition, specific taxa, or overall microbial development in preterm infants.
